Commentary.Commentary: Right then! From Pallekele we move to Colombo with 1-1 on the board. The 3rd ODI is on the 19th of June and will start at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). But as you know, you can join us early for the build up. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka says the Aussies bowled really well and he feels they were a few runs short but he believed his bowlers will defend the target. Tells that he knew the pitch but they didn't take the right options with the bat and hopefully improve in the next game. On Chamika Karunaratne, he says he is a born warrior and he delivers evertime. On Dunith Wellalage, he had a lot of trust and was ready to take the risk. Applauds the crowd in the end for supporting them.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says they were poor in the field, the outfield was quite bumpy and but they were disappointing as they should've attacked the ball more. The batter got the starts but failed to carry on and they lost the momentum. On the toss, he says they want to chase in these type of conditions and improve further. Tells that the injuries are not ideal but they have a good squad. Ends by thanking the crowd for supporting.

Chamika Karunaratne, MAN OF THE MATCH, says he was waiting for this moment. He believes in himself and he gave his all today. Adds that everything is planned, he thinks out of the box and he loves to challenge the batsmen and take the risk. On his celebration, he came back after two and a half years and thanks the universe for giving the energy.
... TIME FOR THE PRESENTATION ...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, courtesy Cummins and the rest, Australia had Sri Lanka reeling at 220 for 9 in the 48th over before rain played its part. There was a big delay and eventually Australia needed 216 in 43 overs. Despite most of their batters getting off to starts, they failed to get to the target as it was the Lankan bowlers who held their nerve and came out on top.

Australia will be very disappointed with this loss! They were on top for most of the game. The problem was, none of their batters went onto score big. All of their batters got off to starts but none made it into something significant! In the end, it was a panic situation. The shots from a few can really be questioned but have to say the Aussies just succumbed under pressure and gave it away.

The hosts did not have a lot to defend and they needed to bowl at their best and they did so! They did concede runs initially but as the game went on, the runs also dried up and they also managed to take wickets at regular intervals. All of the bowlers bowled well at sometime in the game. Maheesh Theekshana and Jeffrey Vandersay did not get wickets but the former was a tad unlucky and the latter was economical. The others though, especially the two pacers were absolutely brilliant. They got the big wickets and have to say, it is their spell which won their side the game. A word of praise for both Dunith Wellalage and Dhananjaya de Silva too who were absolutely magical with the ball. They not only applied the breaks but got crucial wickets too. A really good effort from the Lankans in the field.

WHAT A WIN! WHAT A BRILLIANT WIN THIS IS FOR LANKA! What a series this has been barring the first two T20Is. Another thriller of a game. In the end, it is Lanka who held their nerve and won it quite comfortably in the end. Credit to the way Dasun Shanaka captained. There were times, where we were sitting here and questioning the changes he is making, the field placement, the plans he wanted his bowlers to work with but all of that has come off really well and in the end, it is his side which has come out on top.

OUT! KNOCKED OVER! What a win for Sri Lanka! Pallekele goes bonkers as they celebrate the victory. Chameera serves a length ball, tailing on leg, with good pace. Matthew Kuhnemann steps forward to defend but the angle was going against him and the ball hits the stumps. Sri Lanka win by 26 runs.
A length ball, outside off. Josh Hazlewood looks to push it but misses.
FOUR! That is very clever from Josh Hazlewood! A lovely upper cut! Shorter and around off, Josh Hazlewood guides it over the keeper and it goes down to the third man fence.
Short of a length and on off. Josh Hazlewood punches off the inner half of the bat and to point.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in. 31 needed in 39 balls.
OUT! TIMBER! Number 9 down! Sri Lanka can sniff victory now! Length and outside off, Mitchell Swepson goes after it away from the body, he gets an inside edge and it shatters into the stumps.
TWO MORE! Confusion but safe in the end! Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Another run! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Matthew Kuhnemann looks to flick but misses. Wided.

OUT! TAKEN! A really unnecessary shot from Pat Cummins but what about the catch there! Serves it short and on off. Cummins was looking in two minds, to evade or to pull, he goes with the latter but it goes off the top edge and to deep square leg where Dunith Wellalage runs forward, dives and plucks it in front of him. Exceptional catch from him and Australia are losing their way here.
Commentary.Howout: c Dunith Wellalage b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around off. Cummins knocks it to covers. He will look to take a single now.
Short one, outside off. Cummins sits under it.
FOUR! Releases a bit of pressure building! On a length and around off. Cummins lifts it past mid on and it races away to the long on fence.
On a length and outside off. Cummins swings and misses.
On off, shorter, this is guided to point.
Mitchell Swepson is the new man in. Also, it is time for Powerplay 3! 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over.

OUT! RUN OUT! CAREY IS SHORT! Another massive moment in the game as the last recognized batter is out of here. This was not needed, this run was just not needed. This is on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket. They take one. Carey wants a second and goes for it. Brilliant from Chamika Karunaratne as he runs towards the ball, picks it up and throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is referred, replays show that the batter is short. Sri Lanka on top. Well and truly on top. They are into the bowlers now.
A run out appeal! Alex Carey seems in trouble at the keeper's end and the replay shows he is short of his crease.
FOUR! That is a top shot! Length and on off, Carey strokes it on the up through covers. The fielder in the deep, runs to his left but has no chance.
On middle, defended.
Two more! Outside off, this is guided past point for two. A fumble allowed the two.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the huge wicket, huge, huge, wicket. All this while, we here were wondering why is Chamika Karunaratne bowling at the moment! This is why he was given the ball! The crowd here erupts as they know Sri Lanka now have a really strong chance in this game. It is short and outside off, at a good pace. Maxwell looks to drag the pull, he is hurried into it, it goes off the splice towards point. Both point and cover go for it, in the end, it is Shanaka who takes it from covers. Almost a collision but the skipper hangs on. Game on.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: Pat Cummins walks in.
WIDE! That is way too short, it goes well over the batter's head. Wided.
FOUR! That is a strong shot! Fuller and on off, Maxwell thumps it down the ground, over the mid off fielder and into the boundary. Runs needed below 47. Sri Lanka need wickets.
Cuts Carey into half! Beauty! Length and outside off, this lands and jags back in. Carey is beaten as he tries to defend. It goes over the stumps.
Just the one again! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Yet another dot! Another good short one on middle, Maxwell bails out of the pull shot.
Quick run but completed with ease! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Well bowled! Length again and on off, Carey pushes it back to the bowler.
Need more dots to build pressure! Angled into the pads, Carey looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
That is a quick delivery! Shorter and on middle, Maxwell evades it.
Dealing in singles and that will do! Shorter and on middle, Carey pulls, he gets an inside edge onto the body. It rolls on the off side for one.
Singles will do it! Shorter and on off, this is guided to point for one.
Short and into the body, Carey pulls it towards short fine leg. The fielder stops it well. Just the one. Gets away with one does Chamika Karunaratne!
Short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Two more! This is brilliant battig by Maxwell! Slower one and on off, this is pushed through covers for two.
That is not a good shot! Length and outside off, Carey looks to drive it on the up but is beaten! Good over by Chameera but wickets is what Sri Lanka need.
Bowls it on a length and around off, Carey defends it. Sensible batting is all Australia need.
Length and on off, Maxwell opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
A good short one, evaded well.

Really good effort! Desperate stuff from Chamika Karunaratne, just what you need at the moment! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side. Chamika Karunaratne runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two.
Half an appeal but too high! Angled into the pads, Carey looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and goes down to third man. A run taken. Leg bye.
FOUR! Fortunate one but Glenn Maxwell will take it! Flighted ball, on middle. Glenn looks to heave but gets a top edge over mid on for a boundary.
Slides one on middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! This is excellent from Glenn Maxwell! Flatter and outside off. Maxwell gets on the back foot and punches it wide of covers and it races away to the fence.
Short and outside off, cut to covers who lets it through but no run is taken.
FOUR! poor delivery this one! Shorter and around off. It sits nicely for Glenn who pulls it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter, outside off. Maxwell cuts it straight to covers.
Drops it short on middle. Maxwell plays it uppishly and to deep mid-wicket for a single. 75 runs needed now.
Full and outside off. Carey looks to drive but it spins away and goes off the splice over point for a single.
On a length and on middle, Maxwell bunts it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked  to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Much needed! This is very full and outside off. Glenn Maxwell drives it through covers for a boundary.
Wide! This one lands on off and spins sharply away. Maxwell tries to sweep hard but misses.
A low full toss on middle, swept to short fine leg for a single.
Full and on middle. Maxwell leans and looks to work on the leg side but closes his bat face too early and gets a leading edge, past first slip and to short third man.
Full and on off. Defended.
Shorter, outside off, turning more away. Maxwell mistimes his cut on the off side.
Too full and on off, pushed to covers.

OUT! CAUGHT! A big moment in the match as Labuschagne holes one out! He was looking good but fails to continue. Floated, fuller and just outside off. Marnus Labuschagne tries to go inside-out over covers but fails to get the elevation and Dasun Shanaka at covers shows quick reflexes to take it. 84 needed in 88 balls. The game is well and truly on now. One more wicket and Sri Lanka are into the bowlers.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Dunith Wellalage

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off. Carey reverse-sweeps it to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off. Carey reverse-sweeps it to point for one more. Quicker delivery.
Flights this one, full and on off, it spins away. Carey is through the shot as he looks to go over covers but misses and it whizzes past the off stump.
Full and on middle, drilled to long on for one.
Full and on off. Labuschagne paddles it to fine leg for a couple of runs. The fielder runs to his right and cuts it off.
On middle, nudged to square leg.
Tossed up, outside off, not much turn this time. Labuschagne looks to defend inside the line and he misses.
Flatter and outside off, again stays low. Labuschagne slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter and on off. Carey tucks it to square leg for a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.

Leg bye! Tossed up, on a length and on middle. Carey tries to sweep it but misses as the ball stays low and hits him on the inside of the pad. An appeal and the umpire shakes his head. No bat there. Ball Tracker shows the ball spins too much and goes onto miss the leg stump. A leg bye is taken.
Review time! Appeal for an LBW but turned down. Seems close if no bat.
Alex Carey walks out to bat now!

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Wellalage breaks the stand! Tossed up, full and around off. Head tries to slog-sweep it but gets only a good amount of height on it. He fails to get the distance as he tries to clear the longer side of the ground and Charith Asalanka takes it low at deep mid-wicket. 93 runs needed now.
Commentary.Howout: c Charith Asalanka b Dunith Wellalage

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on off, Labuschagne carves it to deep cover for a single.
Full and on off, hit to covers now.
A single as this is drilled down to long on.
On middle, Labuschagne inside edges his drive to mid-wicket.
Three wides! Tossed up on middle, spinning away sharply. Labuschagne looks to paddle but misses and the keeper fails to collect. It rolls to long leg for a couple.
This one turns away, on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
Similar delivery like the previous one and Labuschagne cuts it behind point for a brace.
Shorter and spinning on off. Labuschagne punches off the back foot to covers.
This time punches it through covers, wide of deep point for a couple. 100 runs needed now.
Touch short and on off, punched hard but straight to cover.
Tossed up, slower and outside off. Labuschagne drops it to short third man for one more.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and on off, pushed to long off for one.
Angles a length ball, on off. Labuschagne gets an inside edge as he looks to work on the leg side, onto the pads.
A length ball, outside off. Head cuts it fine to deep backward point for a couple of runs.
A slower one, outside off. Labuschagne strokes it to point off the back foot for one.
This one is too short and outside off. Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Wide! Another bumper but this one is straying down leg. Left alone for a wide.
A bumper on the slower side, outside off. Labuschagne stands tall and looks to pull but misses.
Short of a length and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short in length, outside off. Labuschagne punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower again, cut to backward point. No run. Good start by Dunith Wellalage.
Slower, flatter and outside off. Head slaps it back to the bowler.
Slides a full ball on middle. Head mistimes his sweep to short fine leg.
Tossed up on off, pushed through covers for a single.
Sharp turn there! This lands on off and spins away! Labuschagne is beaten comprehensively as he looks to defend.
Darted on the pads, Labuschagne flicks it to square leg with soft hands and comes back for the second quickly.
Short of a length and on the hips, nudged behind square on the leg side for one more.
A well-directed bouncer this, on the body. Labuschagne is hurried up as he fails to tuck it away cleanly.
A length ball, slower and outside off, it is cut to deep point for a single.
A slower bumper now. Labuschagne pulls it down to deep square leg for one. 100 up for Australia.
Bangs a bouncer, on middle. Labuschagne lets it go.
On a length and outside off. Labuschagne pushes it to point.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Shorter and on off. Head cuts it very late and the ball races away to the third man fence.
Leg bye! Fuller and on the pads. Labuschagne misses his flick and it rolls off the pads on the leg side for a single.
Nicely flighted, full and on middle. Labuschagne looks to flick it but gets a leading edge to point.
This one spins on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for one.
Fuller again, around off. Head jams it out to point.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to mid off.
Marnus Labuschagne walks out to bat now!

OUT! TAKEN! Steven Smith falls to the trap and he is very disappointed with it. A slower bumper, angling on leg. Smith hangs on the back foot as he plays the pull shot but hits it straight to Maheesh Theekshana at short fine leg, as he gets low and takes it well. Another timely wicket for Sri Lanka. They are not letting the game go away easily. 123 needed more.
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off, knocked to point.
A slower one at 117 clicks, length and outside off. Smith waits, waits and waits to play it down to third man but fails to connect.
Leg bye! Length ball, angling on off. Head looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body. It rolls to point for a leg bye.
Length and on top of off. Head guides it to backward point.
FOUR! Beautiful strike from Head! This is a freebie! Fuller, slower and outside off. Head has all the time to loft it over mid off for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off. Smith hangs back and keeps it out.
Around off, Blocked out.
FOUR! Again timed well! This is the third shot, Smith has played the same way! He comes down the track and wrists this full toss, wide of long on for a boundary.
Tossed up on leg, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Deft touch! Shorter and outside off, spinning in. Head dabs it to third man for a brace.
This is full and on off. Head pushes off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Smith seems to be struggling! The physio is out to attend him. Maybe the heat has got to him. Australia will hope, it is just cramp. Smith is fine now to continue.
Fuller and on middle. Smith flicks it to deep square leg and the man at deep mid-wicket runs across, slides and makes a wonderful stop. Two runs.
Length and outside off, punched to covers.
FOUR! That has found the gap! Perfect timing! A full ball, on middle. Smith bunts it through mid-wicket, wide of mid on for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Smith punches it to covers.
Full and on off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Touch fuller and on off, it is worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A maiden from Jeffrey Vandersay! On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up on middle. Head punches to the left of the bowler who jumps and makes a great stop.
A loopy ball, full and on the pads. Head fails to paddle it away and it goes off the pads to leg slip.
Flatter, quicker and around off. Head stays back and keeps it out.
Around off, pushed to covers.

This is full and on off, it lands and spins back in sharply. Head looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the back pads. A huge shout for LBW but nothing given. Dasun Shanaka opts for a review. UltraEdge shows nothing on it and Ball Tracker shows the wickets are missing. Sharp turn there. Not out it is.
On off, blocked out. Four singles off the over.
Too full and wide of off, eased down to long off for a single.
Slow in the air, length and outside off. Smith punches it to covers for one more.
Flatter and on middle. Smith tucks it to square leg.
Angles it onto the pads. Head wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Too full and on off. Smith laps it to short fine leg for a single.
This is wide outside off, fuller and Head slashes and misses.
Slightly short and on off. Head tucks it to square leg.
Full and outside off, this is driven through covers for a single.
Flighted, outside off, spinning away. Smith looks to cut but gets a bottom edge back to the keeper.
Flatter and on off. Smith blocks it out.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Steven Smith comes down the track and converts this into a full toss. He hits it through mid-wicket, in the gap for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, this is worked down to long on with the turn for one. End of a successful over.
On off, fuller, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Tossed up on off, defended.

Drinks! Sri Lanka have done well to send both the openers back but they need a couple of more wickets quickly to get on the front foot in the game. Australia will look for another partnership as 154 more runs are needed. Travis Head walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Warner goes now! Sri Lanka finding a way into the game! This is on a length and drifting around leg. Warner rocks on the back foot and tries to cut but gets cramped for room and is bit late as well to his shot. He misses and the ball hits the leg pole. Warner has given his team a good start but Sri Lanka will look for a couple of more wickets quickly. 154 needed now.
Well bowled! Slower and on middle, Warner lunges and keeps it out.
Flatter and on middle, this is guided to point.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Very full and on off, this is hit to mid off. Not timed that well.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Really nicely played! Short and down the leg side, this is pulled towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Comes down the track and works it to mid on for one.
Tossed up nicely on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, skids through. Smith looks to pull but this goes off the underedge towards mid on.
Jeffrey Vandersay is into the attack.
A single to end! 160 needed in 186 balls. On off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A single as this is pushed down to long off.
Another run! Tossed up on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
That came so slow off the surface! Shorter and outside off, it comes off so slowly off the surface. Smith goes to lift it over covers but gets an inside edge which goes on the leg side.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Leading edge but safe! On middle, Smith closes the face of the bat early, it goes off the leading edge towards point for one.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one. 50 up for Australia.
Tossed up on middle, it is kept out again.
On middle, blocked.
A single now as this is pushed down to long on.

That was very close! Very, very close. Not sure why the review was not taken there! This lands around middle and off. Straightens. Warner looks to play the paddle scoop, he misses to get hit on the pads. A huge shout but turned down. The ball rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken. That looked very close. INFACT, IT WAS OUT! Not sure why Sri Lanka did not go for the review. That is a big, big miss.
Easy run! Shorter and on off, this is guided through point for one.
A dot to end then! On middle, Warner blocks it out.
On off, Warner guides it to point.
Tip and run! On the pads, Smith nudges it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Shorter and outside off, Warner guides it through point for one.
Two! Slower and on middle, Warner sweeps, it goes more off the inner half through square leg for two.
Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle!
Really good over from Maheesh Theekshana! Just the one from it! On off, flatter, Smith gets right behind the line and defends.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked down to mid on for a quick run. Maheesh Theekshana went a little too full there.
Really good stuff! Tossed up on middle, kept out well.
Floats it up on off, Warner looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to point. This is the line he needs to bowl more often.
Shorter again, Warner looks to cut again but chops it to covers.
Well fielded! Shorter and outside off, shorter and outside off, this is slapped towards cover, the fielder sticks his hand out and makes a half stop.
Two more! On middle, this is worked wide of the fielder at long on for a couple more.
Another tossed up ball on middle, Smith works it back to the bowler.
Floats it up and bowls it on middle, Smith works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, Smith works it to mid-wicket.
Steven Smith is the new batter in.

OUT! THREE REDS AND LANKA HAVE A BREAKTHROUGH! The move to get Dhananjaya de Silva on works! This is tossed up, it lands around middle and leg. Finch swings across the line but the ball comes slow off the surface. He misses and is hit on the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. Warner asks Finch to review and he does. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracker shows three reds. Much-needed wicket for the hosts. Can they get another quickly now? 177 more needed. .
Flatter and on middle, stays a touch low. Blocked.
That is going down leg! Angled into the pads, Warner looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. A better over then from Maheesh Theekshana!
Another one flatter and on middle, Warner goes back and blocks it.
Tosses it up on off, blocked.
Quicker and on off, Finch guides it to point and takes one.
Flatter and on off, Finch pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Maheesh Theekshana changes ends.
On the pads, this is worked to square leg.
On off, blocked.
FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Fuller and on off, Finch slams it down the ground and this races away to the long off fence. Australia racing along.
Short ball, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Quick run! On off, Finch pushes it towards cover and takes one.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for two.
A dot to end! On off, blocked.
Short and on middle, Warner flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Thumped away! Short and asking to be hit, this is pulled through backward square leg and this one races away to the fence.
That gripped off the surface! Shorter, a slower one, it lands on middle and then spins away. Warner looks to pull but is beaten.
Shorter and on middle, Warner defends.
Uppish but well short! Fuller and on middle, Warner looks to go over mid on, does not time it that well and it goes on the bounce to that fielder.
Tossed up on off, defended.
FOUR! Off the outer half! This is tossed up on off, Finch looks to go downtown, it squirts off the outer half wide of the point fielder and into the fence. Another fortunate boundary.
Turn! This lands outside off and spins back in. Finch looks to flick but it hits the pad.

Uppish but just wide! Tossed up on off, Warner clears his front leg. He looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half back towards the right of the bowler who is slow to react, it goes down to long off for one.
Attacks the stumps again, Warner looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
That gripped! This is slower, it lands on leg and then straightens. Warner looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge to the point fielder.
Really good from Chameera! Length and on off, Finch defends it.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Finch looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Around off, Warner guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Yet another one on a length and around off, blocked. Good from Chameera so far.
Good length and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
This lands safe! Shorter and on middle, Warner looks to pull, this flies off the top edge but lands away from the fine leg fielder. Two taken. Lucky escape.
On the pads, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
On middle, Warner works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Drags his length back and bowls it on off, this is kept out.
FOUR! Make that three in a row! Full and outside off, Warner creams it through covers, there is a long off who runs to his right but no chance.
FOUR! Short and put away! Outside off, shortish, this is slapped through covers for a boundary. Consecutive boundaries. Good start by Warner.
FOUR! Just wide! First boundary of the chase! This is tossed up outside off, Warner lifts it just wide of the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Maheesh Theekshana.
Goes for the yorker to end, not a bad idea but ends up serving a low full toss, this is pushed to covers.
That has taken off! Well played in the end by Warner! Length and on off, this one lands and then takes off. Warner does well to drop his hands and lets it go to the keeper.
Another single! Angled into the pads, Finch works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.

Right on the money but a misfield sees Warner take one! He gets off the mark and so do Australia. Not the best effort in the field and every run is important when defending a small total. On off, this is pushed towards cover. The fielder lets it through, one taken.
Solid! Another one on a good length and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
That does not bounce a lot! Shorter and on off, Warner gets right behind the line and defends.
